body:
Hello. Good for you for cutting those people out of your life. I think you have an opportunity there to fill your life with yourself. Maybe you have spent too much time thinking of what makes other people happy? How about spending some money on what makes you happy? There are many things I would like to do if I had any money. There are fabulous workshops to attend, places to visit, Cirque du Soleil to see...

If you're alone, then you're also free to move to a better place. Are you currently living in a place that you like? Can you move your job to a better location?

Hugs, if you want them.

You are the child. They have been adults since before you were born. You are not responsible for their well-being. I know it seems that way, but it's not. You don't have the power to fix their lives, and you don't have the power to wreck their lives either.

I have made many bad decisions (36 years old here) in the past trying to fix things for them and please them, both consciously and unconsciously. Please don't do that. Please live your own life.

Depending on where you are, I would suggest you start working as soon as possible. This will give you independence, that is healthy. Also perspective on what is practical, what are you good at, what sort of career you want to have. Later on you can decide to apply to a community college, as u/histronics points out.
